bio.text: Blake Tillery, a Republican, has served in the Georgia State Senate since 2016, representing Senate District 19, and, according to his legislative biography, is chairman of the Senate Appropriations Committee.
He earned a bachelor's degree in International Affairs from the University of Georgia in 2006 and a law degree from the University of Georgia School of Law in 2010.
He practices law in Vidalia, where he lives.
